title: How to Take Your Relationship to the Next Level
coreMove: Commitment clarity means asking, plainly, whether two people want the same future, so you stop bargaining with your time and finally learn whether this can grow.

exampleSpecs.domain: Source case: University of Alberta eight-year study
exampleSpecs.audience: Imani and readers facing commitment clarity
exampleSpecs.stakes: Repeated noncommitment patterns often require self-work, not a new target.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Show Imani using commitment clarity in the source case without controlling another person.
